segments.name: Global Seating
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells commercial vehicle, aftermarket repair and office seats to truck, construction, agriculture and office furniture customers.
segments.evidence: We design, engineer and produce seats for MD/HD truck, bus, construction, agriculture and military markets.

segments.name: Global Electrical Systems
segments.description: Designs and produces low and high voltage cable and harness assemblies, control boxes and dashboard assemblies for vehicle and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Cable and harness assemblies for both high and low voltage applications, control boxes, dashboard assemblies and design and engineering for these applications.

segments.name: Trim Systems and Components
segments.description: Produces plastic trim, instrument panels, cab interiors and accessories such as mirrors and wipers for truck, power sports and specialty vehicle makers.
segments.evidence: Commercial vehicle accessories including wipers, mirrors, and sensors.

revenueModel.text: Original equipment manufacturers, parts and service dealers and distributors pay for customized systems, assemblies and components, including repair and replacement products.
revenueModel.evidence: We believe our products are used by a majority of the North American Commercial Truck manufacturers, many construction and agriculture vehicle original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs"), parts and service dealers and distributors.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company reorganized its operations into three segments: Global Seating, Global Electrical Systems, and Trim Systems and Components.
changes.evidence: During the quarter ended March 31, 2025, the Company completed a strategic reorganization of its operations into three segments: Global Seating, Global Electrical Systems, and Trim Systems and Components.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold its cab structures business, which is reported as a discontinued operation.
changes.evidence: On July 31, 2024, the Company entered into a purchase agreement to sell its cab structures business with operations in Kings Mountain, North Carolina for approximately $ 40 million.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold its First Source Electronics business, the Industrial Automation segment.
changes.evidence: On October 30, 2024, the Company entered into a purchase agreement to sell its First Source Electronics (FSE) business with operations in Elkridge, Maryland for approximately $ 1.5 million, with a note in the amount of $ 0.5 million and earn out potential of an additional $ 1.5 million subject to certain criteria.
